title: trigonella dasycarpa
intro: Trigonella dasycarpa, commonly known as Persian fenugreek, is a plant species belonging to the Fabaceae family. It has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and anti-diabetic properties. The therapeutic actions of Persian fenugreek are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and improve insulin sensitivity. The bioactive constituents of Trigonella dasycarpa include saponins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
